inputs.sha_checks: S1 stats + E2-A fingerprints ply_sha256 == baseline sha (asserted); e3_candidate == prod[~cull] (asserted)

cap50.gauge: production refined poses; injected refit points triangulated in the SAME frame (frozen poses/K); NO Sim3, no realignment

rule.principle: RS discipline: tie points passing THE unified ruler get published; injection side runs STRICTER gates than incumbent side
rule.G0: S1 unified 2-view rule (verified pair + DLT refit + reproj<=3px + theta>=2deg), byte-identical constants
rule.G1: dedup: > 0.02 m from any production point
rule.G2: resurrection guard: >= 0.05 m from every E3-culled point (stricter, injected must not repopulate cleaned zones)
rule.G3: floor guard: floor_h >= -0.015 m on arbitrated plane (stricter than stock E3 -0.1; constructively zero double-floor-band adds)
rule.G4: chair-ROI guard (cap50): no injected point in ROI within 0.05 m of floor
rule.G5: corridor vote: BOTH observation corridors marched (E2-A constants) against E3-candidate solid voxels; either >= 8 solid crossings => cull; no proxy votes (stricter than stock net>=0); too-short corridor = clear (declared)
rule.G7: floor-thickening guard: floor-slab (|y-y_floor|<=0.06) injections kept ONLY as pure hole-fill (tight slab <=0.03 AND new 2cm cover cell AND thickness cell with <8 E3 slab pts) - protects the floor thickness ruler from 2-view depth-noise shell
rule.G6: after-context E2-A four-signature scan on combined cloud; ANY flagged injected point dropped, iterated to fixed point (stricter than stock earn-existence)
rule.colorize: certified recipe: bilinear at obs_xy-0.5 full-res (COLMAP convention), OOB skipped, representative sample = lower-median-luma real sample (2 obs => darker), round+clamp; missing photo => remaining obs; none => NN production color (declared)

trail_signature_points.note: gate is count-level (union must not increase). Context shift detail: injected occupancy ADDS evidence - an e3 point newly flagged S_behind now provably looks through a (newly densified) surface; its own position/status is unchanged, it becomes a candidate for a FUTURE knife, not a new ghost. Unflagged count = injected density legitimately de-wisps sparse real geometry.

check_3_spatial_distribution.note: layering by height above arbitrated floor plane: floor=|fh|<=0.06, object_low=fh<=1.0, wall_high=fh>1.0 (proxy layering, declared)

honesty: evidence rebuilt from sfm_live.db in observation space; NOT byte-exact production finalize replication
injected positions are host DLT refit results with frozen refined poses (structure-only); production would re-triangulate + BA these tracks - positions may differ at mm scale
colorize: 24 registered frames have no photo on disk (cap50); points with zero recoverable samples fall back to nearest-production-point color (904 pts, declared)
representative color with 2 samples = the darker sample (production lower-median rule), not an average

G3/G4/G5-unanimity/G6-zero-flag/G7 are injection-side strictness choices (stricter than user-approved E3 stock rule), chosen so the ghost recheck passes constructively; the cost is conservatism: some real rescue points near cleaned zones/floor band/covered floor cells are left out (counted in funnel)

first-run lesson (disclosed): without G7 the cap50 floor med-cell thickness regressed 0.04844->0.05172 m (+3.3mm) - floor injections into already-covered cells thicken instead of fill; G7 was added in response and the run repeated (this is a rule change made BEFORE any user approval of E6 products, not after)
wallclock = host python proxy, not device numbers; nothing here ships without sign-off
